newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Rules needed for Brazil sugar export tax - DataNet.
newsitem.headline: Rules needed for Brazil sugar export tax - DataNet.

text.p: The new zero sugar export tax in Brazil must be backed up by a transparent mechanism which sets out the criteria for any possible future increase in the tariff, said independent consultants DataNet-Agricommodities.
In the past the government has raised the tax without warning as in 1995 when a sudden 40 percent tax brought exports to a virtual halt, said analyst Aloisio Sotero in a report.
This Sotero likened to the recent boxing match between Mike Tyson and Evander Holyfield when Tyson was disqualified after biting his opponent in the ear.
